workstream: P5 / AC1027 TABLECONTENT indexed border color and visibility overrides

basis.authoritativeSpecification: Open Design Specification for .dwg files v5.4.1, §20.4.101.4.
basis.implementationBoundary: Color admission is restricted to indexed values 1-255 with no extended CMC payload. A set visibility flag admits both specified values; an absent visibility flag requires the default zero field.

profile.fixture: Runtime-authored 2x2 TABLECONTENT using tableContentScalarGrid; no drawing fixture files were added.
profile.unselectedBorderFields: Default border type, lineweight, null linetype, and zero double-line spacing.

implementation.behavior: The bounded writer accepts the tested indexed-color and visibility-only field combinations on one-hot and non-overlapping grouped edge masks. It refuses other border properties, out-of-domain color payloads, and overlapping edge declarations.
implementation.physicalWire: An independent scalar wire observer checks TABLEFORMAT border counts, ordered edge masks, property masks, indexed group-62 values, group-93 values, default companion fields, and GRIDFORMAT terminators.
implementation.typedReadback: Fresh ASCII and binary imports preserve edge masks, property masks, indexed colors, visibility values and order.
implementation.failureRetry: An unsupported border property mask 0x40 is refused for every profile/encoding while preserving a destination sentinel and caller model; restoring the exact original mask permits same-adapter retry and readback.
implementation.fixturePolicy: All inputs are generated in the test at runtime; no external fixture files were added.

limits: Only the AC1027 TABLECONTENT serializer/readback profile is covered; this does not qualify DWG TABLECONTENT output or other DXF versions.
Color indices 0/256, extended CMC/name/book colors, border type, lineweight, linetype, double-line spacing, and overlapping edge declarations remain refused or unqualified.
Wire and typed readback do not establish native CAD rendering, producer completeness, whole-document closure, or public support claims.
next: Implement another source- or consumer-backed border property profile or a distinct remaining CONTENTFORMAT/CELLSTYLEMAP profile; retain strict refusal outside the qualified fields.
